registeredBy: Sam (owner); registered before any run of this version
hypothesis: An AR (lag 0-2 by BIC, without drift) on the yearly change in government debt to GDP forecasts the ratio with a lower RMSE than no change, one and two years ahead.

retestOf.verdict: failed (relative RMSE 1.904 at 1 year and 2.427 at 2 years against no change; better in 30 of 134 and 21 of 120 series)
retestOf.change: Drops the drift (intercept) on the yearly changes, as the policy-rate model already does: version 1 carried each country's average past change in debt forward, and past averages include one-off jumps such as restructurings and crisis years. Everything else is as in version 1.

knownLimits: IMF WEO outturns only; years marked as IMF projections are never used as data or as outcomes.
Values are today's vintage (later revisions included); no real-time data vintages are free for all countries, so this is a pseudo real-time test.
Not compared with past IMF WEO forecasts: the app holds only today's WEO vintage, so an IMF benchmark cannot be scored without look-ahead. A later version can add it once past vintages are stored.
A re-test drafted after version 1 failed, so it carries less weight than a first test: one change, chosen on a stated principle, and no further versions will be tried if it fails.
